## Species Matrix Function
```{r species_matrix}
create_matrix_by_rarity <- function(rarity_threshold,
                                    tree_data_raw,
                                    veg_cover_raw,
                                    shrub_data_raw,
                                    ground_cover_raw,
                                    cogon_sites_raw,
                                    quadrat_counts_df) {

  total_sites <- nrow(cogon_sites_raw)

  # --- Pre-filter by growth form ---
  tree_data_raw  <- tree_data_raw %>%
    filter(Growth == "Tree")

  veg_cover_raw  <- veg_cover_raw %>%
    filter(Growth != "Shrub" & Growth != "Tree")

  shrub_data_raw <- shrub_data_raw %>%
    filter(Growth == "Shrub" | Growth == "Tree")

  # --- Filter ground cover (remove stumps) ---
  ground_cover_raw <- ground_cover_raw %>%
    filter(Ground_Cover_Type != "Stump")

  # --- Filter by frequency ---
  filter_by_frequency <- function(df, threshold) {
    freq <- df %>%
      group_by(Species) %>%
      summarise(Frequency = n_distinct(Plot) / total_sites * 100) %>%
      filter(Frequency >= threshold)

    df %>%
      filter(Species %in% freq$Species)
  }

  tree_data_filtered  <- filter_by_frequency(tree_data_raw, rarity_threshold)
  veg_cover_filtered  <- filter_by_frequency(veg_cover_raw, rarity_threshold)
  shrub_data_filtered <- filter_by_frequency(shrub_data_raw, rarity_threshold)

  # --- Shrub Cover Conversion ---
  shrub_cover <- shrub_data_filtered %>%
    mutate(Cover = Line_End - Line_Start) %>%
    group_by(Species_Name, Plot) %>%
    summarise(Total_Cover = sum(Cover, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Percent_Cover = Total_Cover / 3000 * 100)

  # --- Herbaceous Cover Conversion ---
  ground_cover_renamed <- ground_cover_raw %>%
    rename(Species_Name = Ground_Cover_Type)

  veg_cover_combined <- ground_cover_renamed %>%
    full_join(veg_cover_filtered,
              by = c("Date", "Observer", "Weather", "Plot", "Site",
                     "Quadrat", "Canopy_Cover", "Species_Name", "Cover", "Cover_Per")) %>%
    left_join(cogon_sites_raw, by = "Plot")

  veg_cover_summed <- veg_cover_combined %>%
    group_by(Plot, Species_Name) %>%
    summarize(total_cover = sum(Cover_Per, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  avg_species_cover <- veg_cover_summed %>%
    left_join(quadrat_counts_df, by = "Plot") %>%
    mutate(avg_cover = total_cover / total_quadrats)

  # --- Merge Herb and Shrub Cover ---
  combined_cover <- avg_species_cover %>%
    full_join(
      shrub_cover %>% select(Plot, Species_Name, Percent_Cover),
      by = c("Plot", "Species_Name")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      overlap_flag = ifelse(!is.na(avg_cover) & !is.na(Percent_Cover), TRUE, FALSE),
      final_cover = case_when(
        !is.na(avg_cover) & is.na(Percent_Cover) ~ avg_cover,
        is.na(avg_cover) & !is.na(Percent_Cover) ~ Percent_Cover,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )

  # --- Species Matrix ---
  species_matrix <- combined_cover %>%
    select(Plot, Species_Name, final_cover) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Species_Name)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = Species_Name,
      values_from = final_cover,
      values_fill = 0
    )

  return(species_matrix)
}
```

## Stress Runs
```{r stress_runs}
# Define the parameters
rarity_thresholds <- c(0, 1, 3, 5, 10) # Species must be in at least 0%, 1%, 3%, 5%, or 10% of sites
k_values <- 1:8 # Test dimensions 1 through 8

# Create an empty data frame to store the results
all_stress_results <- data.frame(
  rarity = numeric(),
  k = integer(),
  stress = numeric(),
  num_species = integer()
)

# --- Start the nested loops ---
for (thresh in rarity_thresholds) {
  
  cat("Running for rarity threshold:", thresh, "%\n")
  

  current_species_matrix <- create_matrix_by_rarity(
    rarity_threshold = thresh,
    tree_data_raw = tree_data,
    veg_cover_raw = Veg_Cover, 
    shrub_data_raw = shrub_data,
    ground_cover_raw = ground_cover,
    cogon_sites_raw = CogonSites,
    quadrat_counts_df = quadrat_count
  )
  
  # Check if matrix is valid (at least 2 species columns)
  if (ncol(current_species_matrix) < 3) {
    cat("  Skipping threshold", thresh, "%: not enough species remained.\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Inner loop for k values
  for (k_val in k_values) {
    set.seed(123)
    nmds_run <- metaMDS(
      current_species_matrix[, -1], 
      distance = "bray", 
      k = k_val, 
      trymax = 100,
      autotransform = FALSE,
      trace = 0 
    )
    
    # results
    result_row <- data.frame(
      rarity = thresh,
      k = k_val,
      stress = nmds_run$stress,
      num_species = ncol(current_species_matrix) - 1 
    )
    all_stress_results <- rbind(all_stress_results, result_row)
  }
}

print(all_stress_results)
```

## Scree Plots
```{r scree_plots}
ggplot(all_stress_results, aes(x = k, y = stress, color = as.factor(rarity))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.20, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.10, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgreen") +
  annotate("text", x = max(k_values) * 0.9, y = 0.21, label = "Stress = 0.20", color = "red", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = max(k_values) * 0.9, y = 0.11, label = "Stress = 0.10", color = "darkgreen", size = 3) +
  
  labs(
    title = "NMDS Stress vs. Number of Dimensions",
    x = "Number of Dimensions (k)",
    y = "Stress Value",
    color = "Rarity Filter\n(% of Sites)"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Final NMDS
```{r final_nmds}

species_matrix <- create_matrix_by_rarity(
  rarity_threshold = 0,
  tree_data_raw = tree_data,
  veg_cover_raw = Veg_Cover,
  shrub_data_raw = shrub_data,
  ground_cover_raw = ground_cover,
  cogon_sites_raw = CogonSites,
  quadrat_counts_df = quadrat_count
)


set.seed(123)
final_nmds <- metaMDS(species_matrix[, -1], 
                      distance = "bray", 
                      k = 4, 
                      trymax = 250,
                      autotransform = FALSE)

final_nmds$stress

# Extract site scores
site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(final_nmds, "sites"))
site_scores$Plot <- species_matrix$Plot 

plot_metadata <- CogonSites %>%
  distinct(Plot, .keep_all = TRUE)

site_scores <- left_join(site_scores, plot_metadata, by = "Plot")

# Extract species scores
species_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(final_nmds, "species"))
species_scores$species <- rownames(species_scores)
```

# Ordination with Environmental Overlay
```{r env_overlay}
cogon_cover_data <- species_matrix %>%
    select(Plot, Avg_Cogongrass_Cover = Imperata_cylindrica)

site_scores <- left_join(site_scores, cogon_cover_data, by = "Plot")


env_vars <- site_scores %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(-starts_with("NMDS"), -any_of(c("Site", "Muname", "SoilType", "Camera")))


print(names(env_vars))


set.seed(123)
env_fit <- envfit(final_nmds, env_vars, permutations = 999, na.rm = TRUE)

env_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(env_fit, "vectors"))
env_scores$variable <- rownames(env_scores)
env_scores$p_value <- env_fit$vectors$pvals

# significant vectors (e.g., p < 0.05)
sig_env_scores <- subset(env_scores, p_value < 0.05)

plot_C <- ggplot(site_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Avg_Cogongrass_Cover), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1) + 
  
  geom_segment(data = sig_env_scores,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = NMDS1 * 0.8, yend = NMDS2 * 0.8),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "black") +
               
  # labels for the vectors
  geom_text_repel(data = sig_env_scores,
                  aes(x = NMDS1 * 0.9, y = NMDS2 * 0.9, label = variable),
                  color = "black",
                  fontface = "bold",
                  size = 2.5,  
                  min.segment.length = 0, 
                  box.padding = 0.5) +  
                  
  labs(
    title = "C) Environmental Drivers",
    x = "NMDS Axis 1",
    y = "NMDS Axis 2",
    color = "Cogongrass\nCover (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_equal()
```

## PERMANOVA
```{r permanova}

# --- Calculate Avg Cogongrass Cover per Plot ---
avg_cogongrass_cover <- species_matrix %>%
  group_by(Plot) %>%
  summarize(Avg_Cogongrass_Cover = sum(Imperata_cylindrica, na.rm = TRUE) / n(), .groups = "drop")

# --- Merge with CogonSites metadata ---
plot_metadata <- CogonSites %>%
  distinct(Plot, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(avg_cogongrass_cover, by = "Plot") %>%
  filter(Plot %in% species_matrix$Plot) %>%
  arrange(match(Plot, species_matrix$Plot))  # align with species_matrix rows

all(plot_metadata$Plot == species_matrix$Plot)

# --- Bray-Curtis dissimilarity ---
species_matrix_numeric <- species_matrix %>%
  select(-Plot)  # exclude Plot column
dist_matrix <- vegdist(species_matrix_numeric, method = "bray")

# --- PERMANOVA ---
set.seed(123)
permanova_result <- adonis2(
  dist_matrix ~ Avg_Cogongrass_Cover,
  data = plot_metadata,
  strata = plot_metadata$Site,
  permutations = 999
)

print(permanova_result)
```

## Regional NMDS and PERMANOVA
```{r regional_nmds_permanova}
run_region_nmds <- function(region_sites,
                            region_name,
                            rarity_threshold = 0,
                            k_dim = 4) {
  
  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat("Region:", region_name, "\n")
  cat("Sites:", paste(region_sites, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("=============================\n")
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Subset metadata
  # -----------------------------
  region_metadata <- CogonSites %>%
    filter(Site %in% region_sites)
  
  if (nrow(region_metadata) < 5) {
    cat("Too few plots in region. Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Filter raw datasets to region plots
  # -----------------------------
  region_plots <- region_metadata$Plot
  
  tree_region  <- tree_data  %>% filter(Plot %in% region_plots)
  veg_region   <- Veg_Cover  %>% filter(Plot %in% region_plots)
  shrub_region <- shrub_data %>% filter(Plot %in% region_plots)
  ground_region <- ground_cover %>% filter(Plot %in% region_plots)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Create species matrix
  # -----------------------------
  region_species_matrix <- create_matrix_by_rarity(
    rarity_threshold = rarity_threshold,
    tree_data_raw = tree_region,
    veg_cover_raw = veg_region,
    shrub_data_raw = shrub_region,
    ground_cover_raw = ground_region,
    cogon_sites_raw = region_metadata,
    quadrat_counts_df = quadrat_count
    )

  # -----------------------------
  # NMDS
  # -----------------------------
  set.seed(123)
  region_nmds <- metaMDS(region_species_matrix[, -1],
                         distance = "bray",
                         k = k_dim,
                         trymax = 250,
                         autotransform = FALSE,
                         trace = 0)
  
  cat("Stress:", region_nmds$stress, "\n")
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Extract site scores
  # -----------------------------
  site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(region_nmds, "sites"))
  site_scores$Plot <- region_species_matrix$Plot
  
  site_scores <- left_join(site_scores,
                           region_metadata %>% distinct(Plot, .keep_all = TRUE),
                           by = "Plot")
  # -----------------------------
  # PERMANOVA (continuous cover)
  # -----------------------------
  # Keep only plots that survived matrix filtering
  valid_plots <- region_species_matrix$Plot
  permanova_data <- region_metadata %>%
    distinct(Plot, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    filter(Plot %in% valid_plots) %>%
    arrange(match(Plot, valid_plots))
  
  # Reorder species matrix to match metadata
  region_species_matrix <- region_species_matrix %>%
    filter(Plot %in% permanova_data$Plot) %>%
    arrange(match(Plot, permanova_data$Plot))
  
  # Final safety check
  stopifnot(all(permanova_data$Plot == region_species_matrix$Plot))
  
  # Create distance matrix
  dist_matrix <- vegdist(region_species_matrix[, -1], method = "bray")
  
  # Run PERMANOVA
  set.seed(123)
  permanova_result <- adonis2(
    dist_matrix ~ Imperata_cylindrica,
    data = region_species_matrix,
    permutations = 999
    )
  
  print(permanova_result)
  

  return(list(
    nmds = region_nmds,
    site_scores = site_scores,
    permanova = permanova_result
  ))
}
```

## Patchwork
combine the three regional NMDS plots into a single figure
```{r regional_patchwork}
make_region_plot <- function(results_object, region_title, x_range, y_range) {
  
  hulls <- results_object$site_scores %>%
    group_by(Status) %>%
    slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2))
  
  ggplot(results_object$site_scores,
         aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
    geom_polygon(data = hulls,
                 aes(fill = Status),
                 alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Status), size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        Invaded     = "#D55E00",
        Non_Invaded = "#0072B2"
      ),
      labels = c(
        Invaded     = "Invaded",
        Non_Invaded = "Non-Invaded"
      )
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        Invaded     = "#D55E00",
        Non_Invaded = "#0072B2"
      ),
      labels = c(
        Invaded     = "Invaded",
        Non_Invaded = "Non-Invaded"
      )
    ) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = x_range, ylim = y_range) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title    = region_title,
      subtitle = paste("Stress =", round(results_object$nmds$stress, 3)),
      x        = "NMDS1",
      y        = "NMDS2",
      color    = "Status",
      fill     = "Status"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

# Compute shared axis limits across all three regions
all_scores <- bind_rows(
  central_results$site_scores,
  north_results$site_scores,
  south_results$site_scores
)

x_range <- range(all_scores$NMDS1) * 1.05
y_range <- range(all_scores$NMDS2) * 1.05

plot_cf <- make_region_plot(central_results, "A)", x_range, y_range)
plot_nf <- make_region_plot(north_results,   "B)", x_range, y_range)
plot_sm <- make_region_plot(south_results,   "C)", x_range, y_range)

final_region_figure <- (plot_cf / plot_nf / plot_sm) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("Regional_NMDS_Comparison.png",
       final_region_figure,
       width  = 8,
       height = 14,
       dpi    = 600)
```
